record.original_question: Classify compact Riemannian manifolds whose holonomy group is special.

evidence.quote: Classify compact Riemannian manifolds with special holonomy group

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Berger's theorem states that the holonomy group of an irreducible, simply connected, non-symmetric Riemannian manifold (M, g) of dimension n must be one of the following subgroups of O(n), referred to as the special (or restricted) holonomy groups:
- SO(n) (generic case),
- U(m) with n = 2m (Kähler manifolds),
- SU(m) with n = 2m (Calabi–Yau manifolds),
- Sp(m) with n = 4m (hyperkähler manifolds),
- Sp(m)·Sp(1) with n = 4m (quaternion-Kähler manifolds),
- G_2 with n = 7,
- Spin(7) with n = 8.

The problem is: classify, up to isometry (and equivalently up to diffeomorphism type with the relevant geometric structure), all compact Riemannian manifolds whose Riemannian holonomy group is one of these special (i.e., non-generic) groups. In particular, give a complete classification of compact manifolds for each entry of Berger's list, including the exceptional cases G_2 and Spin(7), and the Ricci-flat Kähler (Calabi–Yau) case.
artifact.category_tag: Special holonomy on compact Riemannian manifolds
artifact.status_search_result: Berger's list constrains the possible special holonomy groups, and many compact examples have been constructed (notably Joyce's compact G_2 and Spin(7) manifolds, and Calabi–Yau manifolds via Yau's theorem). However, a full classification of compact Riemannian manifolds with special holonomy remains open: e.g., the diffeomorphism classification of compact G_2 and Spin(7) manifolds, and the classification of Calabi–Yau and hyperkähler manifolds in higher dimensions, are all active and unresolved problems.

status_evidence.title: G2 manifold - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: Compact manifolds with G2 holonomy were first constructed by Joyce; classification remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Compact manifolds of exceptional holonomy are constructed but not classified.

status_evidence.title: Constructing compact manifolds with exceptional holonomy
status_evidence.claim: Construction methods are known but no classification is given.
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys construction of compact G_2 and Spin(7) manifolds via resolution of orbifolds.
